sources.note: Main homepage. Describes MDLog as voice-controlled clinical documentation app for iPhone/iPad. Testimonial from LTC physician in Cincinnati.

ONC certification disclosures. Lists all certified criteria, CQMs, required additional software (NewCrop, EMR Direct), practice setting as Ambulatory, and price transparency statement. Links to Real World Testing plans/results 2022-2025.

Detailed pricing page listing all modules: Clinical Documentation ($249/mo), Full EMR ($299/mo), PCC interface ($100/mo), ePrescribe ($50/mo), Patient Portal ($30/mo), CCM ($50/mo), Direct messaging ($250/yr). FAQs about data storage, multi-facility support, user roles.

LTC solutions page describing PointClickCare and MatrixCare integrations, LTC-centric workflow, voice-controlled care, automated billing, care coordination, CCM, patient portal, and ACO data sharing features. Testimonial from Alzheimer's clinic in El Paso.

Landing page with detailed feature descriptions: voice dictation, multi-practitioner/multi-facility workflow, PQRS/quality measure reporting, rapid onboarding (5 minutes), CSV patient import from billing systems.
MatrixCare partner marketplace listing. Describes MDLog/MatrixCare integration for downloading patient demographics and medical info, posting notes back, and sending billing info to billers.
PointClickCare marketplace listing for MDLog. Page required JavaScript rendering; content not fully accessible but referenced in other sources.
Referenced in web search results. SLI Compliance usability test report for MDLog v5.0 with LTC clinicians showing high task success rates for core documentation functions.
Referenced in web search results. F6S listing with reviews and pricing information for MDLog.
